summary: This note describes the Bird-class patrol vessel, a class of large patrol boats built for the Royal Navy. It consists of five ships, named Kingfisher, Cygnet, Peterel, Sandpiper and Redpole. The note is very brief and gives no further details on construction dates, dimensions or service history.
one_line: The Bird-class patrol vessel was a five-ship class of large patrol boats built for the Royal Navy.
